response.original_title: [Escalate-Guide] Silversea Cruises Escalation Process: Complaints, Refunds & Support
response.overview: To escalate a complaint or request a refund with Silversea Cruises, call customer support at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) and explicitly ask to be transferred to a supervisor, manager, or tier-two escalation team. Onboard Escalation Onboard Support: Visit Guest Services for immediate issues  +1-866-254-7549, requesting a manager or Hotel Director if needed, and keep detailed notes of all interactions  +1-866-254-7549.Post-Cruise or Phone Support Documentation & Submission: Prepare your booking details  +1-866-254-7549 and evidence, request a case number for tracking, and submit a written claim via Silversea Contact Channels if unresolved  +1-866-254-7549.
